reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: What an absolute life saver for the skin barrier. I have dry and dehydrated mature skin and this cream is perfect. It’s thick in consistency and take care not to over apply. It absorbs nicely and really keeps the skin moisturised all day. I use this in colder months - probably not the best for hot and humid summers. But it’s perfect for cold and or dry climates. It has improved my dehydration a lot.
reviews.zh: 對皮膚屏障嚟講真係救星。我係乾性加缺水嘅熟齡肌，呢款乳霜啱晒。質地厚身，注意唔好搽太多。吸收得好好，皮膚全日都keep住保濕。我喺凍嘅月份用——夏天熱同埋潮濕嘅時候就未必最適合。不過對寒冷或者乾燥嘅氣候就完美。用咗之後我缺水嘅情況改善咗好多。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: This feels great for my sensitive combo skin with mild rosacea. Feels rich and hydrating. Reminds of Tower 28 SOS recovery cream but sensitive skin friendly without causing pimples or clog pores. Glad I got 2 and will definitely repurchase again
reviews.zh: 我係輕微玫瑰痤瘡嘅敏感混合肌，用落感覺好正。質地豐盈又保濕。令我想起 Tower 28 SOS 修復霜，但係敏感肌用得，又唔會生暗瘡或者塞毛孔。好開心買咗兩支，一定會回購。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: ベタつきはないけど何に効果があるのかわからなかったです。翌朝乾燥が気になるとかはなかったです
reviews.zh: 唔會黐笠笠，但係唔知有咩效果。第二朝起身都唔覺皮膚特別乾燥。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: This is my absolute favorite moisturizer for the winter months. I have dry skin all year round but it of course worsens in the winter time. This panthenol cream helps my skin from becoming irritated during the harsh dry winter months. It keeps me moisturizer and helps my skin barrier stay healthy.
reviews.zh: 冬天嘅至愛保濕霜。我成塊面一年四季都偏乾，冬天當然仲嚴重。呢款泛醇乳霜幫我嘅皮膚喺又凍又乾嘅冬天避免受到刺激。幫我keep住保濕，皮膚屏障都健康咗。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: The first time when i usea this cream my face felt like there was bumps all over it. But when i woke up the next morning my face was so smooth and hydrated. After using it for a while i didnt get the bumps anymore after i applied it. I think it was just my skin barrier what was really broken but now my skin is amazing. I recommend buying this cream if you need a think cream what moisturizes and makes skin barrier strong.
reviews.zh: 第一次用嘅時候塊面好似成面都係粒粒。但係第二朝起身塊面又滑又保濕。用咗一段時間之後，再搽都冇再起粒粒。我諗只係我皮膚屏障已經嚴重受損，而家皮膚狀態好到不得了。如果你需要一支厚身、保濕同埋強化皮膚屏障嘅乳霜，我推薦你買。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: The cream may work well for someone with oily skin. It is light, absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any shine after application. After application of the cream, there is a feeling of a thin layer that keeps skin moisturized. I like that cream doesn't have any smell.
reviews.zh: 呢款乳霜可能啱油性肌嘅人。質地清爽，吸收得快，搽完之後唔會有油光。搽完之後感覺有一層薄薄嘅保護膜keep住皮膚保濕。我鍾意呢款乳霜冇任何味道。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL 1+1 Special Set
reviews.text: First and foremost, the cream's key ingredient, soybean extract, is a skincare powerhouse. Known for its rich nutrient profile, soybean extract offers a multitude of benefits, and this cream harnesses them brilliantly. It's a boon for hydration, making it an excellent choice for those with dry or dehydrated skin. From the moment I applied it, my skin felt instantly plump and well-moisturized.
reviews.zh: 首先要講，呢款乳霜嘅主要成分大豆萃取係護膚界嘅強者。大豆萃取以豐富嘅營養見稱，好處多多，呢款乳霜就用得好出色。佢嘅保濕效果一流，係乾性或者缺水肌嘅好選擇。搽完即刻覺得皮膚飽滿又保濕。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Soybean Panthenol Cream 80mL (+Soybean Panthenol Cream 20mL)
reviews.text:
RoundLab Soy Panthenol Cream
This cream is very thick. When you squeeze it out of the tube it stays put together in one form. This cream is great for both dry and humid seasons since it’s thick but not oily at all. My skin felt like baby skin after using it. If you have dry skin, this will be perfect for morning and night. This is sensitive skin approved. 

I use this cream day and night. I use it as a base before Amuse Power Cushion and it doesn’t pull at all. I use about 2 pea size amt. to cover my face and neck.
reviews.zh:
RoundLab Soy Panthenol Cream
呢款乳霜好厚身。唧出嚟之後keep住一團唔散。雖然質地厚但完全唔油，所以無論乾燥定潮濕嘅季節都好啱用。用完之後皮膚好似BB肌咁。乾性肌嘅話，呢支早晚都用得。敏感肌都用得。

我日夜都用呢款乳霜。會用佢做底妝底霜再上 Amuse Power Cushion，完全唔會黐住。大約用兩粒青豆咁大嘅量就搽到塊面同頸。
